snippets.output: Singulair is the brand name for montelukast; it is an oral tablet, not an inhaler.
Montelukast is a leukotriene receptor antagonist used for the maintenance treatment of asthma and to relieve symptoms of seasonal allergies.
Montelukast is available in various oral formulations including tablet form, chewable tablet form, and oral granule for suspension form; it is not available in inhaler form.
